description: Source code for MIME type utility functions in Chromium project, including MIME type mapping, parsing, and boundary generation.

classes.name: MimeUtil
classes.description: Singleton utility class for MIME type operations, including mapping, parsing, and validation.

methods.name: GetMimeTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Retrieve MIME type based on file extension.

methods.name: GetMimeTypeFromFile
methods.description: Determine MIME type from file path.

methods.name: GetWellKnownMimeTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Get well-known MIME type from extension.

methods.name: GetPreferredExtensionForMimeType
methods.description: Get preferred file extension for a given MIME type.

methods.name: MatchesMimeType
methods.description: Check if a MIME type matches a pattern, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: ParseMimeTypeWithoutParameter
methods.description: Parse MIME type string into top-level type and subtype.

methods.name: IsValidTopLevelMimeType
methods.description: Validate if a MIME type's top-level type is recognized.

methods.name: GetExtensionsForMimeType
methods.description: Retrieve list of file extensions associated with a MIME type.

methods.name: GenerateMimeMultipartBoundary
methods.description: Generate a unique boundary string for MIME multipart messages.

methods.name: AddMultipartValueForUpload
methods.description: Append a form-data part with value to multipart upload data.

methods.name: AddMultipartValueForUploadWithFileName
methods.description: Append a form-data part with filename to multipart upload data.

methods.name: AddMultipartFinalDelimiterForUpload
methods.description: Append final boundary delimiter for multipart upload.

methods.name: ExtractMimeTypeFromMediaType
methods.description: Extract MIME type from media type string, optionally handling comma-separated types.
